title.narrative: Sports for Development and Sports Development initiatives in Papua New Guinea (PNG) 2019 - 2024

description.narrative: The activities under this investment focus on Sport for Development and Sports Development initiatives that aims to empower women, girls, boys, men and people with a disability, to develop communities through sport and to strengthen relationships and build closer collaboration with Australia. Activities include using sport to engage and connect with PNG communities by providing opportunities to participate in programs that focus on promoting healthy lifestyles, social inclusion, gender equality and creating leaders for the communities. It also looks at removing barriers to participation in sport and physical activity enabling inclusive and positive relationships to having harmonious and healthier communities. Activities also support capacity building of athletes and officials through extracurricular education and training focusing on empowering and equipping the athletes with life skills needed for life after sport. This investment will cover financial years 19/20 - 2023/24
